lines: Middle Eastern crisis Gaza war Gaza genocide, Gaza humanitarian crisis Gaza's civil defence agency reports four people killed by Israeli fire, including three in a drone strike on a food-carrying vehicle in Gaza City and one by gunfire in Jabalia. Israel says it targeted operatives. (AFP via France 24) (Reuters) (Al Jazeera)
Yemeni civil war Houthi–Saudi conflict Saudi Arabia intercepts three missiles fired at Riyadh by the Houthis. (Al Jazeera)

Russo-Ukrainian war 2026 drone incursions into the Baltic states and Finland The Finnish defence ministry imposes temporary airspace and maritime restrictions after a drone struck a Russian cargo vessel in international waters of the Gulf of Finland, causing a fire. (AFP)

2026 Bangladesh garment workers protests At least 80 garment factories in Savar and Ashulia, Bangladesh, declare general holidays after workers stage sit-ins and work stoppages over minimum wage demands, while police announce that 96 people, including five labour leaders, have been arrested in connection with the 4 November clashes on the Dhaka–Aricha Highway. (The Business Standard) (The Daily Star)
Laid-off garment workers in Rupganj, Narayanganj District, block roads by felling trees and burning tires over unpaid wages. (The Business Standard)
Border Guard Bangladesh deploys 90 platoons across seven districts, with four more on standby, amid ongoing political violence and strike action. (Dhaka Tribune)

Japan–Saudi Arabia relations The Japanese trade ministry announces that Saudi Arabia agreed to triple the volume of crude oil stored in Japan to 24 million barrels, under Japan's joint stockpiling system with Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, and the United Arab Emirates. (Japan Today)
At least four people are killed and 35 others are injured in a fire at a power station in Basra, Iraq. ((Reuters)
Indonesia–European Union trade relations Indonesia and the European Union sign trade and investment agreements that will lift 98.5% of tariffs on EU goods. (Euronews)
